title: Generics, Collections & Exception Handling
summary: Generics giup kiem tra kieu luc bien dich (bounded type, wildcard, type erasure); Collections Framework to chuc du lieu qua List/Set/Map; Exception hierarchy phan biet checked/unchecked va try-with-resources tu dong dong resource theo thu tu nguoc khai bao.
prerequisites: Da hoan thanh Day 7 (Interface, Inner Classes, Enums, SOLID Principles).
outcomes: Viet duoc generic method voi bounded type parameter.
Chon dung cai dat List/Set/Map phu hop tung tinh huong.
Phan biet checked va unchecked exception, thiet ke exception hierarchy hop ly.
Dung try-with-resources thay cho finally thu cong khi lam viec voi AutoCloseable.

blocks.text: Generics cho phep mot lop, interface hoac method thao tac tren kieu du lieu duoc tham so hoa, giup trinh bien dich phat hien loi ve kieu ngay luc bien dich thay vi de loi roi den runtime moi phat hien.

Truoc khi co generics, cac collection (nhu List) luu Object va lap trinh vien phai ep kieu tuong minh moi khi lay phan tu ra - de gay ClassCastException luc runtime neu ep sai kieu. Khai bao generic nhu List<Integer> giup trinh bien dich kiem tra kieu ngay tai diem them/lay phan tu, loai bo hoan toan nhu cau ep kieu thu cong.

Wildcard '?' dung khi khong can quan tam kieu cu the: '? extends T' (upper bounded) cho phep doc phan tu kieu T tro len nhung khong duoc them vao (producer); '? super T' (lower bounded) cho phep them phan tu kieu T tro xuong (consumer).

Type erasure: trinh bien dich Java xoa toan bo thong tin kieu generic sau khi bien dich xong (bytecode khong con biet List<Integer> khac List<String>) - day cung la ly do generics khong dung truc tiep duoc voi kieu nguyen thuy (int, double...), chi dung duoc voi kieu tham chieu (Integer, Double...).

Java Collections Framework (theo Trail chinh thuc cua Oracle) gom cac interface goc nhu Collection, List, Set, Map cung cac lop cai dat va thuat toan di kem, cung cap mot kien truc thong nhat de luu tru va thao tac tren nhom doi tuong.

Theo cach phan nhom cua Java Collections Series, cac cai dat pho bien duoc chia theo tung nhom interface: List (ArrayList, LinkedList), Set (HashSet, LinkedHashSet, TreeSet), Map (HashMap, LinkedHashMap, TreeMap), moi nhom co dac diem rieng ve thu tu va trung lap.

columns: Cho phep phan tu trung lap?
rows: Tuy cai dat (HashSet: khong; LinkedHashSet/TreeSet: co)
Key khong trung, value co the trung
Tuy cai dat (HashMap: khong; LinkedHashMap/TreeMap: co)

blocks.text: Bai hoc Exceptions trinh bay co che xu ly loi cua Java: khi mot doi tuong exception duoc nem (throw) trong luc thuc thi mot method, luong thuc thi binh thuong bi ngat va JVM tim kiem noi xu ly (catch) phu hop.

Phan cap exception bat dau tu Throwable, chia thanh hai nhanh chinh: Exception (bao gom checked exception va nhanh con RuntimeException la unchecked exception) va Error (loi nghiem trong cua JVM, khong nen tu catch de xu ly).

Checked exception (ke thua truc tiep tu Exception, khong qua RuntimeException) bat buoc phai duoc khai bao trong chu ky throws hoac xu ly bang try-catch, kiem tra ngay luc bien dich. Unchecked exception (ke thua tu RuntimeException) khong bi kiem tra luc bien dich, thuong dai dien cho loi lap trinh (vi du: NullPointerException).

Hai anti-pattern pho bien can tranh: (1) 'nuot' exception bang mot catch block rong khong lam gi ca, khien loi bien mat khong dau vet; (2) dung return hoac throw ben trong khoi finally, vi no se ghi de (che khuat) hoan toan gia tri return hoac exception dang duoc nem tu khoi try/catch tuong ung.

Cu phap try-with-resources (tu Java 7) cho phep khai bao resource (kieu AutoCloseable) ngay trong ngoac don sau tu khoa try; resource se duoc tu dong dong (goi close()) khi khoi try ket thuc, ke ca khi co exception xay ra, khong can khoi finally thu cong.
Mot khoi try-with-resources co the khai bao nhieu resource cung luc, phan cach nhau bang dau cham phay.
Thu tu dong resource nguoc voi thu tu khai bao: resource khai bao sau cung se duoc dong truoc, resource khai bao dau tien duoc dong sau cung.

commonMistakes: Bat exception chung chung bang catch (Exception e) roi bo qua (nuot loi) thay vi xu ly hoac re-throw dung loai exception cu the.
Dung return/throw ben trong khoi finally, vo tinh che mat gia tri hoac exception that su cua khoi try/catch.
Khai bao kieu nguyen thuy (int, double) lam type argument cho generic (vi du List<int>) - Java khong cho phep vi type erasure chi hoat dong voi kieu tham chieu.

practices.prompt: Dieu gi phan biet checked exception voi unchecked exception (RuntimeException)?

choices.text: Checked exception bat buoc khai bao throws hoac try-catch, duoc kiem tra luc bien dich; unchecked thi khong
Checked exception chi xay ra luc runtime, unchecked chi xay ra luc bien dich
Unchecked exception khong the duoc catch bang catch block
Khong co su khac biet nao, day chi la quy uoc dat ten

practices.hint: Xem lai phan phan cap Throwable -> Exception -> RuntimeException.
practices.explanation: Checked exception (ke thua Exception, khong qua RuntimeException) bi trinh bien dich bat buoc xu ly; unchecked exception (ke thua RuntimeException) thi khong.
practices.rubric: Chon dung dinh nghia checked vs unchecked.

practices.prompt: Trong mot khoi try-with-resources khai bao 'try (A a = new A(); B b = new B()) { ... }', resource nao duoc dong (close()) truoc?

choices.text: b (resource khai bao sau cung duoc dong truoc)
a (resource khai bao dau tien duoc dong truoc)
Ca hai dong dong thoi, khong co thu tu xac dinh
Khong resource nao duoc tu dong dong

practices.hint: Thu tu dong nguoc voi thu tu khai bao.
practices.explanation: try-with-resources dong resource theo thu tu nguoc lai voi thu tu khai bao: b duoc dong truoc, a duoc dong sau.
practices.rubric: Chon dung resource duoc dong truoc.

practices.prompt: Viet mot generic method 'static <T extends Comparable<T>> T min(List<T> items)' tra ve phan tu nho nhat trong danh sach (gia dinh danh sach khong rong).
practices.hint: Dung compareTo() de so sanh tung phan tu, giu lai phan tu nho nhat da thay.
practices.explanation: Bounded generic method dam bao T co the so sanh duoc (Comparable<T>) tai thoi diem bien dich.
practices.rubric: Danh gia method dung bounded type parameter dung, duyet toan bo danh sach, tra ve dung phan tu nho nhat.

practices.prompt: Giai thich type erasure anh huong the nao toi viec khong the tao 'new T[10]' hoac 'new ArrayList<Integer>()[5]' (mang cua kieu generic) trong Java.
practices.hint: Sau type erasure, trinh bien dich khong con biet T la kieu gi luc runtime nen khong the cap phat mang dung kieu.
practices.solution: Vi type erasure xoa het thong tin kieu generic cu the sau khi bien dich, JVM luc runtime khong biet T thuc su la kieu gi de tao mang dung kieu do (mang trong Java can biet kieu phan tu cu the luc tao) - nen Java cam truc tiep 'new T[]' va 'new List<X>[]'.
practices.explanation: Type erasure la ly do sau xa cua nhieu han che ky la trong generics ma lap trinh vien Java hay gap.
practices.rubric: Danh gia hoc vien lien ket dung type erasure voi han che tao mang generic.

enhancedExercises: Viet mot custom exception hierarchy 3 tang (vi du: AppException -> ValidationException -> MissingFieldException) va mot method minh hoa catch dung tung tang.
Viet mot lop tu tao cai dat AutoCloseable, mo mot 'ket noi' gia lap trong constructor va dong no trong close(), roi dung trong try-with-resources voi 3 resource cung luc.
